mimic_acquisition.selection: lowest SHA256 UTF-8 of seed|patient|subject_id; within patient lowest SHA256 of seed|record|study_id; tie by source ID; no replacements
mimic_acquisition.split: order selected patients by SHA256 of seed|split|subject_id, tie by ID; floor cumulative boundaries 65%, 75%, 85%; all records inherit split
mimic_acquisition.signal_scope: WFDB header and signal only, with both publisher SHA256 hashes verified; do not download Clinical Database, MIMIC-IV-Note or note linkage

before_performance: complete or record every acquisition failure without replacements
verify physical amplitude, gain, 12 canonical leads, duration, hashes and patient isolation
report within-source and historical overlap controls, distinguishing untested comparisons
freeze machine-reference ontology, label audit, thresholds, calibration, eligible supports, metrics and promotion rules
do not load retained outcomes for training, validation or calibration
do not access CODE-15% outcomes for model selection

design.zero_shot: released models, frozen preprocessing and thresholds; machine statement agreement is not clinical validation
design.mimic_adapted: held-out MIMIC patients; not a different hospital
design.code15_transfer: five shared rhythm labels; one evaluation after model freeze; no P4 endpoint claim
